review_method: Independent original map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, independently registered outlines, wider context, imprints and credits. All 85 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with original source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins. Each original primary viewport, projected coordinate system and full-precision GPTS/LPTS controls was reopened. Full six-parameter affines retain both cross terms and explicitly apply original MediaBox/CropBox offsets. All 85 Northern Sheet and 25 West-Central Sheet registrations were independently recomputed; eight original detail/context pixel arrays match fresh PDF renders. Maximum control residuals are below 0.001 PDF point, measuring affine consistency rather than shoreline accuracy. First Northern observations preserved the Whitestone material gap; fresh West-Central pixels and complete geometry were independently inspected before revised conclusions, closing that gap. All three full-feature correspondence reviews are complete at generalized identity scope. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
